name: Krista Liney
bio: Krista is a commercial director based in LA. Prior to her directing career, she was SVP Brand Creative for HISTORY. She took her years of experience guiding a creative marketing team and translated that into leading film teams. Krista has directed music videos for artists such as Justin Bieber, Tyga, Lynyrd Skynyard and many more. Her brand work includes directing commercials for HULU, FOX, ABS, and CBS to name a few. She holds awards from Promax, Clio, Telly, the Emmys, the NCAAP, and more.
